challenge.better_approach: Exempting cairn in test_cli_reaches would hide a real gap: every other shimmed device has its launcher, and the orchestrator ruled the launcher belongs. Moving the shortcuts into 0/bin would collide with bin/cairn's shortcut dispatch at bin/cairn:344-349. One file is the smallest move.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That cli_main(CairnShim, []) needs no bus to print the device line; measured rc=0 printing device: cairn / class: cairn/devices/cairn/.
challenge.prior_art: cairn/devices/tester/0/bin/tester is the shape; 96c1c2ea5ce9 made the floor walk run when any class verb lacks its link, so a new class file is laid with no other change. Checked git log for cairn/devices/cairn/0/bin: never existed.
challenge.real_collision: None. bin/cairn dispatches cairn/devices/cairn/bin/<verb> as shortcuts; 0/bin/cairn is a different address and the walk only reads 0/bin.

answers.falsifier: Done when a scratch box's wiring walk links devices/cairn/0/bin/cairn to the class file and that link, run bare, exits 0 printing device: cairn. Wrong intent if the cairn device was meant to have no self-named launcher and test_cli_reaches should exempt it.
answers.from_idea: none, because the orchestrator ordered it from akienasus_cc_0's test_cli_reaches run of 2026-11-12, which found cairn/devices/cairn/0/bin absent in class-space; the walk that would lay it is cairn_wire_instances at cairn/devices/recovery/bootstrap.sh
answers.how: Add cairn/devices/cairn/0/bin/cairn, cli_main over CairnShim, shaped like cairn/devices/tester/0/bin/tester. The top-level shortcuts at cairn/devices/cairn/bin/ (start, stop, restart) stay where they are. Live fire: the orchestrator removes akiendelllinux's hand-placed launcher at PROVEME so its floor lays the link.
answers.traces_to: Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics: the launcher is laid by the walk, not placed by hand); Law 9 (the Dell's green was earned by a hand-placed file, not by the build).
answers.what: The cairn device carries a self-named launcher at cairn/devices/cairn/0/bin/cairn, so the floor lays ~/.cairn/devices/cairn/0/bin/cairn on every box like every other device's, instead of a box reading green only on a hand-placed file.

bullets.text: The cairn device never had a class-space launcher; akiendelllinux's test_cli_reaches green rode a hand-placed file from Sep 2. Armed by hand, not unwired.

title: The cairn device carries a self-named launcher at cairn/devices/cairn/0/bin/cairn, so the floor lays ~/.cairn/devices/ca
